entries.0914d9d4b87f4de5: It makes and sells power products and related parts, including generators, cultivators, snow blowers, lawn mowers, outboard motors, and engines installed in other companies' products. Aircraft and aircraft engine businesses, such as the small business jet "HondaJet", are also included here.
entries.0affcf4f4b0b4ddb: To support sales of Honda products, it provides loans and leases to customers and financing to dealers through financial [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] in Japan, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil and Thailand.
entries.51db74e51b7a6e9f: It conducts research and development, production and sales of four-wheel vehicles (automobiles) and related parts. It makes sedans, compact cars, SUVs, minivans and kei cars.
entries.67f977f4d1b7077a: It conducts research and development, production and sales of two-wheel vehicles (motorcycles), ATVs and Side-by-Sides, and related parts. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, consolidated unit sales were highest in Asia, including India, by region.
entries.8c198d7e4ad8e3fe: Engines for other brands' products (OEM engines)
entries.8c67d72c1db9a48d: A company that centers on motorcycles and automobiles, also makes generators and lawn mowers, sells them worldwide, and also handles loans and leases for buyers.
